reviewMethod: Visual shortlist review from Commons previews and file metadata; selected originals were downloaded, checksum-verified, cropped and inspected at 2560x1440. Alternatives were not redistributed.

themes.intent: Amber-lit urban night, dark riverfront and a cyberpunk-compatible atmosphere without invented neon.
themes.selected: Buenos Aires at night — Luis Argerich

candidates.title: Buenos Aires at night
candidates.reason: Wide real night panorama, warm city light and usable 16:9 crop.

candidates.title: Buenos Aires by night
candidates.reason: Strong landmark composition, but the explicit Obelisk/avenue reads more as a tourist landmark than the layered city atmosphere sought.

candidates.title: Puerto Madero, Night
candidates.reason: Good city/water reflections; selected panorama has more continuous urban skyline and horizontal space.

themes.intent: Quiet maritime blue hour over Beagle water, cold light and southern distance.

candidates.title: Beagle Channel -m
candidates.reason: Soft twilight and calm water; large landscape original supports a careful wide crop.

candidates.title: Beaglekanal
candidates.reason: Authentic landscape, but below target resolution and less suitable as a 2560px-wide default.

candidates.title: Beagle-Kanal Ushuaia
candidates.reason: Portrait aerial view would require a destructive desktop crop.

themes.intent: Dense green wetland, dark lagoon water, floating vegetation and a calm dawn mood.
themes.selected: Esteros del Ibera, Corrientes, Argentina, Jan. 2011 - Flickr - PhillipC (1)

candidates.title: Esteros del Ibera… PhillipC (1)
candidates.reason: Nikon D90 photograph; lagoon framed by vegetation gives the theme a quiet layered composition.

candidates.title: Esteros Del Ibera… PhillipC (3)
candidates.reason: Genuine alternate wetland view; selected image has a more enclosed lagoon composition.

candidates.title: Esteros Del Ibera… PhillipC (5)
candidates.reason: Sunset-oriented alternate considered; selected image aligns better with the green lagoon identity.

themes.intent: Humid grassland and water channels, open air, green and earth rather than rustic props.
themes.selected: Drone Laguna de rocha — Alejandro Barrios

candidates.title: Drone Laguna de rocha
candidates.location: Laguna de Rocha, Buenos Aires Province
candidates.reason: Native 16:9 aerial composition reads as humid grassland and river channels.

candidates.title: Argentine Pampas
candidates.reason: Correct region; selected aerial has more distinctive water and vegetation geometry.

candidates.title: Atardecer en la Meseta El Fresco
candidates.reason: Authentic moonrise landscape, but too small for a crisp 1440p default.

themes.intent: Cold glacier blue, high mountain forms and open Patagonian scale.

candidates.title: Perito Moreno Glacier Panorama
candidates.location: Los Glaciares National Park, Santa Cruz
candidates.reason: High-resolution panorama; crop balances ice, mountains and sky.

candidates.title: Perito Moreno Glacier South
candidates.location: Los Glaciares National Park, Santa Cruz
candidates.reason: Strong close detail of the ice face; less broad landscape and tighter crop.

candidates.title: Perito Moreno Glacier panorama
candidates.location: Los Glaciares National Park, Santa Cruz
candidates.reason: Large five-frame panorama; the selected source gives a better balanced desktop crop.

themes.intent: Jujuy mineral bands, high-altitude daylight, rose, ochre and violet shadow.

candidates.title: Serranía de Hornocal 03
candidates.reason: Layered mineral color supports the theme's natural rose/ochre/violet palette.

candidates.title: Quebrada de Humahuaca 05
candidates.reason: Wide mineral scene, but road/valley composition is less color-distinct than Hornocal.

candidates.title: Quebrada de Humahuaca 06
candidates.reason: Real Andean landscape; subdued ridges were a weaker match for the theme's mineral color direction.
